newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Mandela buys home picked by his sweetheart - paper.
newsitem.headline: Mandela buys home picked by his sweetheart - paper.

text.p: South African President Nelson Mandela has bought a new home, chosen by his sweetheart Graca Machel, a local newspaper reported on Sunday.
The couple had looked at several mansions on sale near his residence in Johannesburg's leafy Houghton area and Mandela decided to buy the one chosen by Machel, the Sunday Times said.
The widow of Mozambique's former president Samora Machel officially lives in her home country, but spends a couple of weeks each month with Mandela.
The paper said Mandela was believed to be paying 2.1 million rand ($471,000) to its previous white owner, who emigrated to Australia.
Mandela would share the house with his grandchildren and sell the old property.
The couple have no intention of getting married, a decision criticised by Anglican Archbishop Desmond Tutu as a bad example to young South Africans.
